career_ladder.note: Probationary Engineers in Bharat Electronics Limited undergo 1 year of probation in Executive Grade E-II and are confirmed as Engineers. Progression through executive grades is based on annual Performance Management System (PMS) ratings, minimum residency periods, and Departmental Promotion Committees (DPC).

steps.source_label: BEL Probationary Engineer Recruitment Scheme & Grade E-II Pay Scale

steps.designation: Additional General Manager (AGM) / Deputy General Manager

exam_scheme.note: Selection process consists of a Computer Based Test (CBT) and Personal Interview. The CBT carries 85% weightage and the Personal Interview carries 15% weightage for final selection merit. Negative marking of 1/4th (0.25) mark applies for every incorrect response in the CBT.

stages.source_label: BEL Probationary Engineer Scheme of Examination and Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Part I: Technical Engineering Knowledge (Core Discipline Subjects)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 35% marks for General/OBC/EWS and 30% for SC/ST/PwBD in each part

papers.paper_name: Part II: General Aptitude and Reasoning Ability

stages.source_label: BEL Probationary Engineer Interview Guidelines (Shortlisted candidates called in 1:5 ratio)

papers.qualifying_threshold: 15% weightage for final selection merit; minimum 35% for UR/EWS and 30% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD

stages.stage_name: Stage 3: Document Verification & Pre-Employment Medical Examination

papers.qualifying_threshold: Satisfactory verification of B.E./B.Tech First Class degree and certified medically fit

financial_package.note: Probationary Engineers in BEL are placed in IDA Grade E-II pay scale (₹40,000–₹1,40,000) with starting basic pay of ₹40,000, 58% DA constant as of 2025-07-01, cafeteria approach allowances up to 35%, and company quarters or HRA. Annual Cost to Company (CTC) ranges from ₹12.5 to ₹15 Lakhs.
financial_package.pay_source_label: BEL Executive Pay Structure under DPE 3rd PRC IDA Scales
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Entry Basic Pay of ₹40,000 with 58% IDA (₹23,200), Perks under Cafeteria Approach up to 35% of Basic Pay (₹14,000), House Rent Allowance (9% to 27% = ₹3,600 to ₹10,800 depending on posting unit in Bengaluru/Ghaziabad/Pune/Hyderabad), less statutory Provident Fund (12% of Basic+DA = ₹7,584) and income tax deductions.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) revised quarterly as per AICPI
Perquisites and allowances under Cafeteria Approach up to 35% of basic pay
Performance Related Pay (PRP) variable pay linked to corporate and individual MOU ratings
Company Quarters in BEL townships or House Rent Allowance (HRA) in lieu thereof
Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, and Defined Contributory Superannuation Pension Scheme
Comprehensive medical coverage for self and eligible family members under BEL Medical Rules
